app.title: Field Shift
app.tagline: Plan smarter crop rotations with Earth data.
app.noNasaEndorsement: Independent project, not endorsed by NASA.
welcome.heading: Plan smarter crop rotations with Earth data.
welcome.body: Draw your field, answer a few questions about your farm, and compare three feasible crop rotation strategies built from NASA observations, soil estimates and your own priorities.
welcome.anonNote: No account needed. Your data stays tied to this browser.
field.select.title: Select your field
field.select.subtitle: Search anywhere, draw the boundary, name it, and check the area.
field.search.unavailable: Search is unavailable right now; you can still pan the map.
field.locationDenied: Location unavailable — you can search or pan instead.
field.drawHint: Click points around your field, close the shape to finish.
field.name: Field name
field.areaPending: Draw the boundary to see the area
q.title: Tell us about your farm
q.subtitle: A few short questions — complex data we collect ourselves.
q.irrigation.title: How is your field watered?
q.irrigation.help: This decides which crops can rely on rainfall alone.
q.method.title: Which irrigation method do you use?
q.availability.title: How reliable is your water supply?
q.volume.title: Do you know roughly how much water you can apply?
q.volume.optional: Optional — leave empty if you do not know
q.history.title: What did you grow over the last three agricultural years?
q.history.help: You can list more than one crop per year, mark fallow years, or choose unknown.
q.purposes.title: What do you produce for?
q.purposes.marketNote: Market and profit estimates are not available in this version.
q.constraints.title: Any crops you cannot grow, or other constraints?
q.constraints.bannedHint: Optional — pick crops you do not want recommended.
mixer.title: Set your priorities
mixer.subtitle: The four goals share 100%. Raising one rebalances the others.
mixer.yieldNote: Yield here is a modeled reference, not your profit. Selling stays a declared purpose only.
analysis.title: Analyzing your field
analysis.subtitle: Real data collection and processing — statuses reflect actual work.
analysis.powerUnavailable: NASA POWER is unavailable and no cached data exists. A NASA-backed analysis cannot complete — please retry later.
plans.title: Explore rotation plans
plans.subtitle: Up to three feasible multi-year strategies for your field and priorities.
plans.fewer: Fewer valid plans exist for this field; we show them rather than inventing options.
plans.baselineNote: Current-practice comparison needs a complete 3-year history.
plan.scoreNote: Scores are weighted references (0–100), not field measurements or guarantees.
plan.dataProvisional: Crop trait ranges come from a provisional reference table and are not independently validated.
customize.title: Customize plan
customize.subtitle: Replace one, several or all crops. Only feasible replacements are offered.
customize.similarNote: Whole-rotation re-evaluation shows differences within tolerance; crops are still not identical.
customize.dirty: You have unsaved edits — evaluate changes to see their effect.
evaluate.title: Evaluating your modifications
evaluate.subtitle: Full re-validation of the modified sequence — no cached scores.
compare.title: Compare original vs modified
confirm.title: Your rotation plan is saved
confirm.subtitle: The plan is stored in this browser. No login involved.
confirm.anonNote: Clearing this browser's storage loses access to saved plans. There is no cross-device sync.
home.subtitle: Saved fields and your chosen plan, restored from this browser.
timeline.title: My rotation timeline
timeline.subtitle: Update activities yourself — changes are farmer-reported, never satellite-detected.
insights.title: Field intelligence
insights.subtitle: Climate, soil and suitability context with full provenance.
insights.noData: Run an analysis to collect field insights.
insights.soilUnavailable: SoilGrids estimates are unavailable — shown only when a source responds.
plans.manage.title: Manage your rotation plans
plans.manage.subtitle: Chosen version, alternatives and history of this field's plans.
settings.title: Farm settings & language
settings.updateGeometryHint: Changing the boundary invalidates past analyses for this field.
settings.dataWarning: Data lives only in this browser. Clearing storage loses access to saved fields and plans.
status.regional: Regional estimate — not a field measurement
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Is the backend running?
disclaimer.title: What this tool does not do
disclaimer.body: No profit forecasts, no guaranteed yields, no precise field soil tests. Reference data is regional; consult a local agronomist before costly decisions.
disclaimer.soil: Soil data are estimated from a global map, not a laboratory test.
disclaimer.calendar: A verified planting calendar for your location is not available; we will not guess dates.
disclaimer.yield: Yield is a model-based reference under specified management, not a prediction of your harvest.
disclaimer.anon: Your selected plan is saved in this browser. There is no login or cross-device sync.
disclaimer.profit: Profit and market forecasts are not available in this version.
disclaimer.similar: Similarity is based on re-evaluating the whole rotation; crops are not identical.
settings.clearedNote: Browser key cleared. Reload to start fresh; old data becomes unreachable.
